explanation_full: The KNN model demonstrated the strongest performance among benchmark models, achieving an R2 score of 0.81717, an RMSE of 0.11318, and an MAE of 0.07502. Furthermore, the analysis identified VFA (0.7984), Butyrate (0.7827), and Acetate (0.7641) as the top three features most correlated with the target variable HPR. The time-series diagnostics for KNN showed a high sequence correlation of 0.931488, indicating a strong relationship between actual and predicted values.
